decisive_spans.text: 6 of 14 lymph nodes positive for metastatic disease

response.rationale: The presence of metastatic disease in lymph nodes strongly supports a diagnosis of cancer, making D2 (Sigmoid cancer) a better fit than D9 (Sigmoid colon carcinoma) which does not explicitly mention metastasis in its support items. D1 (Gastrointestinal stromal tumor (GIST)) is contradicted by negative CD117, and D4 (Sigmoid Lymphoma) lacks specific support for lymphoma over other cancers.
